title: Bypassing Repository boundaries with Free Database Queries
pattern: Executing raw database queries directly in user-interface or client code, bypassing standard Repository isolation layers.
why_bad: It leads to business logic leaking into SQL queries and client code. The domain entities become mere data containers, and the domain model becomes completely irrelevant.
detection: Raw SQL strings or direct database connection queries located in controllers, views, or application coordinators.
counterexample: Repository implementation classes utilizing raw SQL to execute structured interface queries.
fix: Enforce strict layered boundaries, routing all persistence and query retrieval through the Repository interface.
